# parse_variable { #wass2s.parse_variable }

```python
parse_variable(variables_list)
```

Extract center and variable names from a variable string.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name           | Type   | Description                                      | Default    |
|----------------|--------|--------------------------------------------------|------------|
| variables_list | str    | Variable string in the format 'center.variable'. | _required_ |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                            |
|--------|--------|----------------------------------------|
|        | tuple  | A tuple containing (center, variable). |

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> parse_variable("NOAA.SST")
('NOAA', 'SST')
```
